description: Move a task: under parent (a subtask; top level when omitted), after previous (first among its siblings when omitted), and into another list of the same account with to_list. A repeating task cannot change lists.

account.description: Which account this writes to: a label from list_accounts. Required; writes have no default.

parent.description: The taskId it goes under; omit for the top level.

previous.description: The sibling taskId it goes after; omit for the first position.

task_list.description: The list's taskListId from list_task_lists or list_tasks; "@default" (the default) is the account's default list.

to_list.description: Another taskListId of the same account to move it into.

name: move_task
title: Move task
